result.summary: The home screen has several layout and content overflow problems: category chips and restaurant cards are clipped, names are truncated, and the last popular listing is cut off by the tab bar.

issues.description: The last restaurant card in the 'Fastest near you' row (Trattoria Piccol…) is clipped on the right, cutting off both the image and the restaurant name.
issues.suggestion: Ensure horizontal cards have enough trailing padding or fade so names and images are fully visible, or allow the row to scroll with a complete last card peek.

issues.description: The second popular restaurant card (pizza with -20%) is cut off at the bottom by the tab bar, so the restaurant name, rating, and delivery details are not visible.
issues.suggestion: Add bottom padding/safe-area inset to the scroll content so cards sit fully above the tab bar.

issues.description: The category filter chips overflow the right edge (Healthy is partially cut off), which can look unfinished if scrolling is not obvious.
issues.suggestion: Add a right fade, extra padding, or a visible scroll affordance so the last chip is not abruptly clipped.

issues.description: Restaurant name 'Trattoria Piccol' is truncated without a full readable title.
issues.suggestion: Allow two-line titles or a slightly smaller type size so names remain complete on standard phone widths.
